basic_details.job_title: SEBI Part-time Counsellor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has invited online applications for the post of Part-time Counsellor on contract basis at its office in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai, for a fixed remuneration of ₹75,000 per month. Applicants need a post graduate degree in Clinical Psychology from a recognised University/Institution and at least two years' post qualification experience in Clinical Psychology. The online application link is open from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026, and selection is by interview.

how_to_apply: Open the online application form through the link in the notice (https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/other/OtherAction.do?doCounsellorForm=yes). The link is also provided on the SEBI website under the Careers Section.
Fill the online application form. The notice says candidates shall mandatorily apply this way.
Submit the application between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026, while the online link remains open.
Applications which are not submitted online shall not be considered. The notice does not list any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: SEBI Part-time Counsellor at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
SEBI office, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai

content_sections.heading: About SEBI
content_sections.text: SEBI is a statutory body established by an Act of Parliament. According to the notice, it exists to protect the interests of investors in securities, to promote the development of the securities market and to regulate it.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from professionals with this qualification and experience. The Board reserves the right to raise the minimum standards for qualifications and experience in order to restrict the number of candidates called for the interview. Meeting the stated conditions therefore does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

rows.details: Post graduate degree in Clinical Psychology from a recognised University/Institution
Minimum of two years' post qualification experience in the field of Clinical Psychology

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Part-time Counsellor is engaged on contract basis at a fixed remuneration of ₹75,000/- per month. The notice states the following terms: No superannuation benefits, namely pension, Provident Fund or gratuity, will be payable. No leave would be admissible. No perquisites or facilities would be made available. Taxes on the income would be deducted at source as per extant rates and Government notifications. The length of the contract is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: SEBI Part-time Counsellor Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide counselling services for employees of SEBI. Work at the SEBI office in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai. Work three days a week, 8 hours per day and 96 hours per month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SEBI Part-time Counsellor
content_sections.text: Open the online application form through the link in the notice ( https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/other/OtherAction.do?doCounsellorForm=yes ). The link is also provided on the SEBI website under the Careers Section. Fill the online application form. The notice says candidates shall mandatorily apply this way. Submit the application between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026, while the online link remains open. Applications which are not submitted online shall not be considered. The notice does not list any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is Interview. The Board reserves the right to modify the selection procedure if it deems fit. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SEBI Part-time Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The online link remains open from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026, so 15 December 2026 is the last date.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for the SEBI Part-time Counsellor post?
faq.answer: A post graduate degree in Clinical Psychology from a recognised University/Institution, plus a minimum of two years' post qualification experience in the field of Clinical Psychology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the remuneration for the SEBI Part-time Counsellor?
faq.answer: A fixed remuneration of ₹75,000/- per month, with taxes deducted at source as per extant rates and Government notifications.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the SEBI Part-time Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Fill the online application form through the link in the notice, which is also on the SEBI website under the Careers Section. Applications not submitted online will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The mode of selection is Interview. The Board may modify the selection procedure and may raise the minimum qualification and experience standards to limit the number of candidates called.

faq.question: Q6. Is the SEBI Part-time Counsellor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is advertised as a Part-time Counsellor on contract basis, and the notice mentions no pension, Provident Fund or gratuity.

faq.question: Q7. What are the working hours and location?
faq.answer: Counselling services for SEBI employees at the Bandra Kurla Complex office in Mumbai, three days a week, 8 hours per day and 96 hours per month.

faq.question: Q8. Will leave or perquisites be given?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no leave would be admissible and no perquisites or facilities would be made available.
